projection: equirectangular, north up, east to the right; lon 0 at the centre
normal: tangent space x=east y=north z=up (OpenGL), true scale from the Dawn HAMO DTM (DLR, 60 ppd), oblateness removed
colour: Dawn mosaic albedo x the previous site map mean tint (saturation 0.5); |lat| > 60..75 lighting flattened (L / local mean, soft clamp 0.7..1.3); shadows filled (ramp 24 px), south pole (wavy ramp 128 px, ring mean) + matched grain 0.45; luminance mean/std of the previous map; highlight soft knee 0.9; pole rows averaged; relief occlusion 0.18
source: USGS Astrogeology: Ceres Dawn FC DLR global mosaic 59ppd/140m (Feb 2016), Ceres Dawn FC HAMO DTM DLR global 60ppd (Oct 2016)
